people.name: Egypt
people.line: Ancient nation; Israelites enslaved there; plagues and Exodus

translations.web: I will give this people favor in the sight of the Egyptians, and it will happen that when you go, you shall not go empty-handed.
translations.bsb: And I will grant this people such favor in the sight of the Egyptians that when you leave, you will not go away empty-handed.
translations.kjv: And I will give this people favour in the sight of the Egyptians: and it shall come to pass, that, when ye go, ye shall not go empty:
translations.asv: And I will give this people favor in the sight of the Egyptians: and it shall come to pass, that, when ye go, ye shall not go empty.
